product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Gourmet Spoon Spatula, one size, Matte Black
features: IDEAL FOR BAKING: This spoon spatula features a flexible silicone head with curved sides ideal for mixing, scooping, and scraping. The head measures 7. 31 inches long x 2. 36 inches wide.
HEAT RESISTANT: The silicone material is safe for all cookware, including nonstick. The spatula is heat resistant to 500°F/260°C.

DURABLE SPOON SPATULA: The nylon fiberglass reinforced head substrate with a silicone overmold provides support for the best performance in the kitchen. The matte ABS handle features a debossed logo, ABS chrome plated bolster, and a stainless steel endcap containing a "KitchenAid 1919" medallion, which pays tribute to the year the KitchenAid brand was founded.
DISHWASHER SAFE: This spoon spatula is dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy
description: This KitchenAid Silicone Spoon Spatula is perfect for mixing, scooping, and scraping your bowl clean. The silicone spoon spatula is safe for all cookware, including nonstick and is heat resistant to 500°F/260°C. The spoon spatula's head substrate is constructed of 30% glass reinfornced nylon with a silicone overmold, making it strong and durable for use in the kitchen. An ABS chrome plated bolster, matte handle and a debossed logo are just some of the design elements that gives this spoon spatula an upscale look and feel. It also features a 1919 Medallion on the stainless steel end cap, paying tribute to the year the KitchenAid brand was founded, and tying the tool in with KitchenAid Electrics. Dishwasher safe for easy cleanup. One year hassle-free replacement and lifetime limited .
